name: autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome due to CTLA4 haploinsufficiency
description: A somatic mutation in the CTLA4 gene resulting in only a single functional gene. Haploinsufficiency for CTLA4 is associated with autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome, type V.
